name: blogger-ai-publisher
description: Connect ChatGPT to one authorized Blogger blog for reading, drafting, verification, and explicitly permitted publishing.

interface.longDescription: ChatGPT handles research, fact checking, SEO writing, and decisions. This private MCP server only reads and manages Blogger posts.
defaultPrompt: Review recent posts in my authorized Blogger blog, find a nonduplicate topic, then prepare a researched article as a Blogger draft. Do not publish it.
